objective: Independently verify the frozen CW-17 candidate (production backend lifetime, entrypoint, ui_v1) against L-CW17-DETACH/START/CONTRACT, deriving expected outcomes from CW-17.md and SPEC s2.7 before reading the implementation.
required_tests: L-CW17-DETACH runtime: start via the real entrypoint (not internal constructors) with two real OMP 18.2.10 (scripted provider, bridge loaded) and the persistent shell; attach, detach, wait more than 60 s, reattach; assert identical backend/OMP/shell/supervisor identities (pid + start time), preserved input owner and control mode, no new run, no duplicate delivery. Also: frontend process killed with SIGKILL while attached must leave the backend alive.

Negative cases: second concurrent start on the same data dir attaches instead of spawning; data dir and socket permissions (0700/0600); stale socket or lock from a dead backend is handled without killing a live foreign process.
L-CW17-START runtime: real Bash and dash selection; SHELL=zsh default does not change the choice; PATH without bash and sh prints start requirements, exits non-zero and leaves no backend.

L-CW17-CONTRACT fixture: version mismatch rejection, framing and size limits, 2 MiB paste and queue-full paste rejected all-or-nothing with a reason visible to the client, malformed frames, client disconnect mid-stream keeps the backend and PTYs.
Regression: run existing tests/contracts, tests/lifecycle and tests/gates/g4_lifetime non-live suites to confirm unchanged v1/ports_v2 behavior.

Characterize (runtime, real bash) host-shell user input through ui_v1 after a confirmed takeover: plain text, arrow keys/ESC sequences, Ctrl-C, and a user-launched foreground program (e.g. `cat` or `python3 -q` REPL). Report which inputs are delivered vs rejected (reason) against C-AC-08 ('수동 입력은 확인된 현재 대상에 전달한다'). Do not change production; report rejection of ordinary interactive input as a material finding.
constraints: No tmux/herdr, no reboot, no credential access beyond running the installed OMP, no delegation, commit or publication. Own and account for every spawned process; exact-identity cleanup only; leaks on the normal path are failures.
report: Return candidate_ready or needs_reroute with failing evidence, per-gate-item evidence level, added cases and counts, frozen production hashes, residue check, and unsupported environments.
